title: Batch 49.2 on the 27B (L32), bridge-word rungs only: the removal ladder's rungs 1-2. On the changed prompt of the clean one-pick scenes, the J++ part taken out at the bridge word at L and at L..L+3, each beside a random subspace of the same share; both readers, both sentence orders
command: export BJ_TARGET=qwen3.6-27b BJ_DEVICE_MAP=; uv run python scripts/x49_ladder.py run --name x49_2_27b --why "Batch 49, test 49.2 (jobs/c3/batch49.yaml and amendment 2; Q49.2): the removal ladder on S, clean design, the 27B's bridge-word rungs 1-2 only (the bridge's Δ's 25 OMP atoms at L32 and at L32..35), random subspace of the same share beside each; sealed"
question: 47.5 took the J++ part out at one token and one layer and the recall kept 0.97; Zach's knock-out takes the top-10 lens directions out at every token over a band and the recall breaks. On the 27B (bridge-word rungs only): in the clean one-pick scenes, does taking the part out at the bridge word, at L and at L..L+3, cost either reader its answers, in either sentence order?
why_it_matters: The 27B is the model where the lookup partly follows the lens; its bridge-word rungs say whether one token (one layer or four) already costs answers there, beside the 9B's and Muse's full ladders.

hypotheses.Q49.2: Q49.2 asks for the 9B and Muse only (the three rules need rungs 3-6); the 27B's rungs 1-2 are descriptive. The job is sealed with the others: per-item outputs only, no verdict; scripts/x49_ladder.py verdict refuses until Dan's Q49.2 answer is committed.

decision_rule: Fixed in advance (jobs/c3/batch49.yaml, 49.2: "qwen3.6-27b: bridge-word rungs only"): no rule on the 27B; the three rules of 49.2 need rungs (3)-(6) and are read on the 9B and Muse. Reported, descriptive, as computed (fixed before any run): the scenes = the 27B's 45m run (x0_necessity --alt fresh, chat), its eligible scenes at L32 (its gate passed; asserted), all of them (574 = 254 locker-first + 320 locker-after; plan in results/x49_ladder/plan-*-27b); order = x0_strata's 'alt locker vs asked pick'. Rung (1) = 47.5's zeroing at the bridge word at L32 (the state minus its projection on the span of the 25 signed-OMP atoms of Δ_L over the J++ lens's letter-token atoms); rung (2) the same at L32..35 (per-layer lens and OMP, on the state as it arrives); beside each, the random subspace of the same share of the bridge token's ||h_S||^2 (X0's random basis, seed 888 + l). Per reader and order group (and all scenes): kept share per arm, cost = kept(random) - kept(removal) and the raw cost kept(none) - kept(removal), with cluster-bootstrap CIs over the bridge items (10,000 resamples, seed 0). Code: scripts/x49_ladder.py verdict (numbers; rules None for a model without rungs 3-6).
controls: beside each rung, a random subspace of the same share of the bridge token's ||h_S||^2 (X0's random basis, seed 888 + l)
S unedited (keeps ~1 by the source run's eligibility; reported)
the lookup on the identical removal
n: 574 clean one-pick scenes (45m's eligible at L32, chat): 254 locker-first, 320 locker-after; 46 bridge items
notes: Batch 49 (Dan, 28 Oct ~14:35), 49.2 on the 27B, bridge-word rungs only (the brief: 'qwen3.6-27b: bridge-word rungs only'); queue item 7 with the 9B and Muse. Sealed: the run writes manifest, plan, cases, outcomes (both readers, 5 arms: none, zero1, rand1, zero2, rand2), norms and 10 examples' greedy texts; no verdict. By hand after Dan's Q49.2 is committed: uv run python scripts/x49_ladder.py verdict (all three models). Estimate from the mats box ledger (results/jobq/ledger_sesterce-h100x2.jsonl): x45p_27b took 243 s wall for ~250 items x 7 arms x 2 readers (~3,500 reads) and 2 forwards per item; here 574 x 2 x 5 = 5,740 reads and 4 forwards per item, plus the 25-atom OMP at 4 layers: ~500 s = 0.14 h -> 0.3 with margin.

command: export BJ_TARGET=qwen3.6-27b BJ_DEVICE_MAP=; uv run python scripts/x49_report.py run --name x49_6_27b --why "batch 49, test 49.6 (jobs/c3/batch49.yaml; Q49.6, sealed): the report reworded twice on 47.10's 500 C0 scenes, O only, question-last; greedy text, the top token and the candidate read per scene and wording"
question: 47.10's report reader failed the 9B's gate on slot 1 (read right in 0.03 of slot-1 scenes, 0.92 / 0.66 on slots 2 / 3). Is that the wording? Reworded twice, does the report of slot 1 recover (above 0.2 under either wording)?
why_it_matters: If slot 1 stays unreportable under two other wordings, the failure is the model's (an appendix curiosity); if it recovers, 47.10's gate failure was the wording, and the curiosity is dropped. The 27B (slot 1 0.71 under 47.10's wording) is the reference model beside the 9B.

hypotheses.Q49.6: Dan's answer in predictions/2026-10-28_dan.md (Q49.6); not committed when this spec was written, so the run is sealed: no rates in the job (scripts/x49_report.py verdict and view refuse until the answer is committed).

decision_rule:
Fixed in advance (jobs/c3/batch49.yaml, 49.6): "If slot 1 stays <= 0.2 on the 9B under both wordings, keep as an appendix curiosity; if it recovers, drop." As computed (fixed by the agent before any run; Dan may override before the run): scenes = 47.10's (x47_report.build_items: x6_routes C0, seed 2510, 500 generated, the same drops), O only; wordings: 'position' = 47.10's digit report with its tail 'listed 1, 2 or 3?' replaced by Dan's 'listed in position 1, 2 or 3 of the list?' (digit answer 1 / 2 / 3), 'sentence' = 'Which of the three locker sentences - the first, the second or the third - gives the locker of

's pick?' (word answer, read token ' first' / ' second' / ' third', 47.10's); question-last (tasks_v2's chat prompt, 47.10's headline order). Reads: X0's chat read (a digit wording with the space token appended, the word wording right after 'Answer:'): read = the top token is the answer token (decides: 47.10's gate measure); said = 47.10's said on 8 greedy tokens and cand = the highest of the three answer tokens, beside; for the digit wording, the share that says the asked item's locker digit (the lookup's answer). Rule on slot 1's read accuracy, question-last, point estimate (EPS 1e-9): 'stays' if <= 0.2 under both wordings, 'recovers' if > 0.2 under either; the action from the 9B, the 27B's label beside. No gate (the accuracies are the outcome; the scenes' lookup read 1.00 / 1.00 on the 9B / 27B in 47.10). Cluster-bootstrap CIs over bridge items (10,000, seed 0) beside every rate. Scored by hand: scripts/x49_report.py verdict; view.
controls: 47.10's two wordings on the same scenes (report, report_digit; question-last, O), read from its committed competence.jsonl beside the new ones: on the 9B slot 1 is 0.03 read, 0.33 said, 0.29 candidate under 47.10's word report
accuracy by true slot (slots 2 and 3 beside slot 1): a wording that breaks every slot is not a recovery of slot 1
the candidate read's confusion (true slot x preferred slot), and for the digit wording the share answering the locker digit instead
n: plan on the 27B tokenizer (28 Oct, results/x49_report/plan-20261028T133606Z): 500 items (236 C0 scenes dropped by 47.10's rule: A and B have the same number of legs), 32 bridge entities; true slot 1 / 2 / 3: 147 / 180 / 173; answer tokens one each (digits 1-3; ' first', ' second', ' third')
notes: Batch 49 (Dan, 28 Oct ~14:35), test 49.6; queue item 12 (last). Sealed: the run writes manifest, plan, cases (each wording's prompt, ids and answer) and outcomes (per scene and wording: greedy text, said, top token, read, the candidate's preferred slot); no rates. --orders last,first adds 47.10's question-first order (about doubles the cost); not in the command. By hand after Dan's Q49.6 is committed: uv run python scripts/x49_report.py verdict --runs x49_6_27b qwen35_9b_x49_6 (CPU); view --name x49_6_27b. Seeds: 0 the bootstrap and the examples, 2510 the routes scenes. Cost (ledger, sesterce-h100x2): x47_10_27b's competence ran ~0.41 s per reader-scene (two rows: O and S, 8 greedy tokens and two reads); this run reads 500 scenes x 2 wordings = 1000 reader-scenes of one row (8 greedy tokens + one read), ~0.3 s each = ~300 s, plus ~90 s load: ~0.11 GPU-h, entered as 0.1.
